structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun-graduated token (PumpSwap pool, created ~2026-09-15) called ASTEROID has just gone parabolic: +294% in the last hour, +1945% in 24h, on ~$76-80k h1 volume against a $77k market cap and only $24.6k pool liquidity. Trigger-time h1 buys/sells (276/327) and 24h unique buyers (538) show broad participation, not just a handful of wallets. The token's on-chain fee routing ("Fees to @rebeccaperrotto via UsePaid") ties it to the real Liv Perrotto / SpaceX "Asteroid" mascot tribute story, but it is one of at least four separate ASTEROID-ticker tokens live right now, and it is NOT the token the official memorial site (asteroid.charity) points to — that site exclusively promotes a token on Bags.fm, a different fee-routing platform. This looks like a copycat/parallel launch piggy-backing on a real charity narrative and a real X handle, not the community-recognized "official" coin.

narrative.description: The underlying story is real and emotionally powerful: Liv Perrotto, a teenage cancer patient, designed the "Asteroid" plush zero-gravity indicator that flew on Polaris Dawn (Sept 2024); she passed away in early 2026; Elon Musk/SpaceX then named Asteroid the official SpaceX mascot in April 2026, and her mother Rebecca Perrotto has publicly thanked Musk on X. This produced a large, media-covered memecoin run (~$28M mcap) around April 2026.
narrative.why_spreading: The emotional/Elon hook is genuinely shareable and has driven large pumps before, but I found no evidence of a fresh news catalyst dated near 2026-09-26 that explains why THIS specific token is spiking today. The pump could be an independent pump.fun rediscovery/copy of an old narrative rather than a new event, and the huge h1 volume relative to a tiny $24.6k pool is consistent with a short, self-contained squeeze rather than broad external attention.
